title: Jump to Projects section from desktop navbar
description: Verifies a visitor can use the desktop navigation to smoothly scroll to the Projects section and land with that section visible.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Set the viewport to a desktop size
Click the navigation link for Projects
Verify the Projects section is in view

title: Navigate to Contact from mobile hamburger menu and auto-close
description: Verifies a mobile visitor can open the hamburger menu, select Contact, and the menu closes after navigation with the Contact section visible.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Set the viewport to a small mobile size
Toggle the mobile navigation menu open
Click the navigation link for Contact
Verify the mobile navigation menu is closed
Verify the Contact section is in view

title: Hero animations and background render on first load
description: Verifies the hero content loads with the particle background and the typing animation cycles without blocking the page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the hero area to finish initial rendering
Verify the particle background is displayed behind the hero content
Verify the role tagline text changes over time

title: Hero secondary CTA scrolls to Contact
description: Verifies the secondary hero call-to-action scrolls the visitor to the Contact section.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the hero call-to-action to get in touch
Verify the Contact section is in view

title: Active section highlight updates while scrolling
description: Verifies the navbar updates the active section indication as the visitor scrolls through sections.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll down until the Projects section is in view
Scroll down until the Experience section is in view
Verify the navbar indicates Experience is the active section

title: Send a contact message via the form
description: This test verifies a visitor can submit the contact form with valid inputs and receives a success confirmation after the loading state completes.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Contact section
Fill "Ava Tester" into the name field
Fill "ava.tester@example.com" into the email field
Fill "Hello, I would like to connect about an opportunity." into the message field
Submit the contact form
Verify a loading state is shown while the message is being sent
Verify a success confirmation is visible indicating the message was sent

title: Hero primary CTA scrolls to Projects
description: Verifies the primary hero call-to-action scrolls the visitor to the Projects section.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the hero call-to-action to view work
Verify the Projects section is in view

title: View project cards with essential details
description: Verifies a visitor can reach the Projects section and see project cards with titles, descriptions, and tech tags rendered.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Projects section
Verify multiple project cards are displayed with a title, description, and tech tags

title: Open a project demo in a new tab from the projects grid
description: Verifies a visitor can open an external project demo link and it opens in a new tab.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Projects section
Click an external project demo link from a project card
Verify a new browser tab opens to an external project demo page

title: Open a footer social profile in a new tab
description: This test verifies selecting a footer social icon opens the corresponding external profile in a new browser tab.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the footer
Click a social icon that links to an external profile
Verify an external page opens in a new tab

title: Hero social links open external destinations
description: Verifies social links from the hero open the expected external destination or mail intent in a new tab/window.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the GitHub social link
Verify an external destination is opened for the GitHub profile
Navigate to /
Click the LinkedIn social link
Verify an external destination is opened for the LinkedIn profile

title: Magnetic hover effect responds to pointer movement on a primary CTA
description: Verifies that hovering over a prominent CTA triggers the magnetic pull effect and the button visually returns to its resting state when the pointer leaves.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the hero section if it is not already in view
Hover over a prominent call-to-action button in the hero section
Move the pointer around within the button area
Move the pointer away from the button
Verify the hovered button shows a subtle magnetic transform while hovered and returns to its default appearance when not hovered

title: Open the email intent from the Contact info card
description: This test verifies a visitor can click the Contact email info link and a mailto intent is initiated.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Contact section
Click the Email contact info link
Verify a mailto intent is initiated

title: Browse Tech Stack with default Frontend category visible
description: Verifies a visitor can reach the Tech Stack section and see the default category selected with its skills displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Tech Stack section
Verify a tech stack category is selected by default and a list of frontend skills is displayed

title: Experience timeline visual elements render
description: Verifies a visitor can reach the Experience section and see the timeline line and timeline markers rendered.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Experience section
Verify the experience timeline is displayed with a vertical line and timeline markers

title: Trigger scroll reveal animations while scrolling
description: This test verifies sections reveal as they enter the viewport during scroll and the content remains visible and usable.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll down the page slowly
Continue scrolling until multiple sections have entered the viewport
Verify sections become visible as they enter the viewport
Verify revealed content remains interactable after the animation completes

title: View all skills by switching to All category
description: Verifies a visitor can switch to the All category and see skills from multiple categories displayed together.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Tech Stack section
Select the All category
Verify skills from multiple categories are displayed in the Tech Stack section

title: Magnetic hover effect works consistently on multiple buttons across sections
description: Verifies that the magnetic hover effect triggers on buttons in different sections without breaking layout or interaction.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the projects section
Hover over an interactive button or link-style button within the projects section
Move the pointer away from the hovered control
Scroll to the contact section
Hover over the form submit button
Move the pointer away from the hovered control
Verify interactive buttons in multiple sections show the magnetic transform on hover and remain usable after hover ends

title: Filter skills to Backend category
description: Verifies a visitor can filter the Tech Stack section to Backend and only backend skills are shown.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Tech Stack section
Select the Backend category
Verify only backend skills are displayed in the Tech Stack section

title: View contact information cards in the Contact section
description: This test verifies the Contact section displays the expected contact info cards so visitors can find email, location, and availability details.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Contact section
Verify contact info cards are displayed
Verify the contact form is displayed

title: Keyboard navigation does not depend on magnetic hover to reveal or enable button actions
description: Verifies that buttons remain accessible and visually focusable via keyboard without requiring hover behavior.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Press Tab repeatedly until a primary call-to-action button receives focus
Press Enter to activate the focused button
Verify the focused button shows a visible focus indicator and can be activated via keyboard without requiring hover

title: Experience entry shows complete role information
description: Verifies an experience entry displays role details including type, period, description, and related tags.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Experience section
Scroll to an experience entry card
Verify an experience entry shows role information, a time period, a description, and skill or technology tags

title: Navbar style changes after scrolling past threshold
description: Verifies the navbar switches to an opaque/blurred style after the visitor scrolls down and remains styled while continuing to scroll.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll down a small amount past the top of the page
Verify the navbar background appears opaque with blur

title: See social icons in the footer
description: This test verifies the footer renders social icons so visitors can discover external profiles and email contact options.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the footer
Verify social icons are displayed for external profiles and email
Verify copyright information is displayed

title: Experience section adapts layout on narrow viewport
description: Verifies the Experience section uses a responsive stacked layout on a narrow viewport without overlapping content.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Resize the viewport to a narrow mobile width
Scroll to the Experience section
Verify experience entries render in a stacked responsive layout without overlap or truncation that blocks reading

title: Magnetic effect does not cause page reflow or overlaps in a dense layout
description: Verifies that the magnetic transform does not cause nearby elements to shift, overlap, or become obscured when hovering a button in a dense section.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to a dense content area containing buttons near other elements
Hover over a button that sits close to neighboring text or cards
Move the pointer around within the button area
Move the pointer away from the button
Verify nearby content does not shift or overlap due to the magnetic hover transform

title: Particle background persists while scrolling page content
description: Verifies the particle animation remains present behind content as the visitor scrolls through multiple sections.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll down until the Tech Stack section is in view
Scroll down until the Projects section is in view
Verify the particle background is still displayed behind the page content

title: Magnetic hover effect remains stable during smooth scrolling between sections
description: Verifies that after smooth scrolling to another section, hovering a button still produces the magnetic effect without jitter or stuck transforms.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Use the navbar to jump to the projects section
Hover over an interactive button in the projects section
Move the pointer away from the button
Use the navbar to jump to the contact section
Hover over the contact form submit button
Move the pointer away from the button
Verify magnetic hover transforms trigger normally after in-page navigation and do not remain stuck after pointer leaves

title: Prevent contact submission when required fields are empty
description: This test verifies the contact form cannot be submitted with required fields empty and the browser shows required-field validation feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Contact section
Submit the contact form
Verify HTML5 required-field validation prevents submission
Verify a required-field validation prompt is shown for at least one required field

title: Skill hover interaction highlights without breaking layout
description: Verifies hovering a skill item triggers a highlight effect and the skills layout remains stable.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Tech Stack section
Hover over a skill item
Verify the hovered skill shows a visual highlight effect and the skill grid remains intact

title: Project card hover shows lift/glow effect
description: Verifies hovering a project card triggers the lift/glow interaction without preventing viewing project details.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Projects section
Hover over a project card
Verify the hovered project card shows a lift or glow effect while remaining readable
